ai-web-dev-2026.name: AI Web Development Contest
ai-web-dev-2026.description: Build an innovative AI-powered web application in 6 hours. Use modern AI APIs and frameworks to create something amazing. Theme: Smart Club Operations.
ai-web-dev-2026.format: Build an AI web app · 6 hrs
ai-web-dev-2026.requirements: Laptop with internet access, basic knowledge of web development
ai-web-dev-2026.rules:
1. Teams must build from scratch
2. Use of AI tools is allowed
3. Must present working demo
4. Code must be open source
